title: Flat scalar extension of a global augmented Cech model
statement: Let C be a small site, phi:R -> B a map of commutative ring sheaves, and I an ideal sheaf [def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-ideal] whose underlying module sheaf is locally finitely generated [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]. Suppose B is flat over R [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules] and R/I -> B/IB is an isomorphism. Let epsilon:K -> R[0] be an unbounded R-module complex [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] with augmented local extended Cech description for I [def-weil-pbc-local-extended-cech-description]. Write r for restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars] and rc for its termwise extension to complexes. Write sigma:R[0] -> rc(B[0]) for the map induced by phi and the single-complex comparison. Assume the derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] used in the local description exist. There are a B-module complex L, an augmentation delta:L -> B[0], and a quasi-isomorphism u:K -> rc(L) such that u followed by rc(delta) equals epsilon followed by sigma. This conclusion concerns augmented complexes only and does not assert any equivalence of complete derived categories.

proof.text: Construct the B-unit complex, identity augmentation and induced map directly; the augmentation equation is functoriality and identity composition.
Apply the local flat Cech comparison on finite generating slices and globalize to obtain the quasi-isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_flat_ringedCech_baseChange
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    {R B : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}} (φ : R ⟶ B) (I : RingedSiteIdeal R)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (siteModuleRings R))]
    [∀ U : C, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (siteModuleRings (R.over U)))]
    (hI : SheafOfModules.IsFiniteType.{u, u, u} I.module)
    (hflat : SheafOfModules.IsFlat
      ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{u}
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map φ)).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit (siteModuleRings B))))
    (hquot : I.IsQuotientIso φ)
    (K : ringedSiteComplex R) (ε : K ⟶ ringedSiteRingComplex R)
    (hK : HasLocalExtendedCechDescription R I.module I.inclusion K ε) :
    let r := SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map φ)
    let rc := r.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let σ : ringedSiteRingComplex R ⟶ rc.obj (ringedSiteRingComplex B) :=
      (HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).map
          (SheafOfModules.LocalizationCech.unitMap φ) ≫
        (HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex r (.up ℤ) 0).inv.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit (siteModuleRings B))
    ∃ (L : ringedSiteComplex B) (δ : L ⟶ ringedSiteRingComplex B)
      (u : K ⟶ rc.obj L), QuasiIso u ∧ u ≫ rc.map δ = ε ≫ σ
